description: Exact @deepseek-ai/dsh versions exercised by verification/. Add a version only after the matching Docker run is green. The lowest entry must equal the lower bound of package.json engines.dsh. nodeImages pins the Node image per DSH version; defaultNodeImage applies otherwise. pins fixes floating pre-release host dependencies to the versions the DSH release was verified against: DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 declares ~4.0.6-alpha.1, so a later alpha.2 patch of cordis/schemastery is installed by default and breaks agent-preset mounting, which the runtime pins back to alpha.1.
